lines.t: Glory to God…
Glacric Universal…
Deep‑space bass, wounded earth…
Children of a broken house, come forth.House lights low, words like knives in the kitchen,
Little hearts break under heat, no one listens.
Empty plates, empty eyes, shadows hanging in the air,
Threats in the hallway, love wasn’t there.You learned to hide every tremor inside,
Smiled on command while your soul flat‑lined.
Serotonin scattered, dopamine on the run,
You froze in the dark, never looked at the sun.Promises twisted into weapons of shame,
Blessings inverted, spoken in vain.
You took every curse like it had to be true,
Till you couldn’t tell their voice from you.But in the after‑shock hum, when the night goes still,
Another Presence presses through your shattered will.
Feet on glass, yet the steps burn bright,
Someone holy walks into your night.Breath on your scars, fire in your chest,
Hands of mercy reaching into your mess.
Where fear once ruled like a tyrant king,
A different Spirit starts to sing.Here comes the flood, deep‑bass healing,
808 thunder, YahuShua revealing.
Neurons light up where the lies once lived,
Serotonin sings, ’cause The Lord forgives.We’re breaking those words that chained our lives,
Glory to God, every trauma survives.
Dopamine rivers in a desert mind,
Seeing with YahuShua’s eyes, we find—We are not what they called us,
We are what He named us.
But the Shepherd walks valleys that used to be deep.
Where panic once choked every breath I drew,
A gentle strength starts pulling me through.Hands that were raised once taught me fear,
Now pierced hands wipe every tear.
Love steps into the scenes I dread,
Rewrites the script that played in my head.The Spirit breathes truth where the torment was loud,
Breaks off the verdicts they spoke in a crowd.
I’m not their failure, not their mistake,
I’m dust He loves, a soul He remakes.Chemical storms and cortisol tides,
Yet peace like a river begins to rise.
Holy fire glows in the limbic night,
Neuro‑grace pulses in resurrection light.What meds couldn’t finish, Your nearness completes,
Love hits harder than the kick on the beat.
A heart long numb starts to feel again,
A quiet Voice says, “You’re more than the pain.”Here comes the wave, deep‑bass healing,
808 thunder, YahuShua revealing.
Neurons light up where the lies once lived,
Serotonin sings, ’cause The Lord forgives.You tune my brain to a Kingdom key,
Chains fall off in Your amnesty.
Dopamine rivers over old dry ground,
With YahuShua’s vision, enemies are found—As broken kids wearing grown‑up skin,
So I lay down the right to win.
GLORY TO GOD!I breathe in Spirit, exhale rage,
Step out of the cell, walk off the stage.
I see my parents through Your scars,
Wounded satellites, falling stars.Forgiveness isn’t saying it was ever okay,
It’s handing You the debt, letting You have Your way.
Their words no longer sit on the throne in my head,
Your whisper is louder than the armies of the dead.You lead me to the place where justice and mercy meet,
Where I can leave the gavel at Your feet.
Blood on the doorposts of my memory wall,
filters opening to white‑light noise.)Now we rise in Glacric light,
Universal praise in the dead of night.
Deep‑bass shaking every curse from the roots,
YahuShua roaring over trauma‑fruits.Hearts once numb now synchronize,
We see this world through His own eyes.
Serotonin, dopamine, Spirit aligned,
Love re‑codes every neuron we find.We are sons, we are daughters,
Pulled like brands from the fire and waters.
GLORY TO GOD!
GLORY TO GOD!House lights low, but I’m not that kid,
The door of the prison has finally slid.
Hands once trembling now lifted high,
Deep‑bass worship under midnight sky.YahuShua, keep my vision true,
Let me see them all like You see You.
Parents, children, enemies, friends—
One broken race that Your mercy mends.Glory to God…
Glacric Universal…
Amen.
